[[File:Dymek_dual_lasers_btm.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The double laser cannons on ''Outrider'' were made by Dymek.]]
'''Dymek''', or '''Dymex''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technologies manufacturing corporation, specializing in weaponry and detonation devices.

Dymek was the company responsible for producing the [[HM-6 Concussion Missile Launcher/Legends|HM-6 Concussion Missile Launchers]] that were equipped on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] and newest [[HM-8]]'s that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] had on her personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. They also produced double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], sufficiently powerful to be illegal for civilian ownership, as [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] used them on the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' and in the ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' novels this company was referred to as Dymex.
